thread:
Kai: Quick sync: I'm trying a rescue-route UX that is cost-aware and signal-rich. Goal: auto-route when signals indicate degradation but avoid noisy micro-fallbacks. Proposal includes modes: safemode (conservative), throttle (sampling), reroute (full switch).

Maria: Nice. What signals are we using beyond 5xx and p95 latency? We should include model confidence histograms and our eval-suite regression score.

Lee: Also add "quota_window_utilization" so policies can opt-out if a customer is near reserved commit. We burned credits last quarter chasing smaller errors.

Kai: Draft policy YAML so console folks can design panels: 

```
policy_id: rescue_low_confidence
mode: reroute
triggers:
  - http_5xx_rate>0.02
  - p95_latency_ms>400
  - conf_histogram.p0_5<0.6
  - eval_regression>0.12
budget_sensitivity: high
fallback_target: open-quant-v3
dry_run: true
audit: timeline,reason_code,sampled_input_hash
```

Sam: Heads up: prefer field name "fallback_target" (clarer) and expose "estimated_cost_delta" in the decision payload so product can show cost impact on the timeline.

Maria: Console UX: each policy row needs a small sparkline for decisions, a heatmap for triggers by minute, and a "Why?" flyout that shows the top 3 signals and the decision path. Dry-run toggle should be prominent with an explanation tooltip.

DevOpsBot: deploy:policy-service/pr-519 -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark: https://ci/reports/pr-519

Lee: For telemetry: recommend tags rescue.policy_id, rescue.reason_code, rescue.estimate_cost_change, rescue.sampled_input_hash, rescue.confidence_bucket. Also include operator_id when an override occurs.

Kai: On precedence: policies should chain but require an explicit "precedes" field. If two policies match, we need deterministic resolution (priority + created_at). Otherwise consoles will show conflicting advisories.

Sam: Simulation: Add a "simulate against date-range" in console that replays historical traces and shows what fraction of requests would have been affected and an estimated monthly cost delta. Important for sales/enterprise customers.

Maria: Can we store sampled inputs hashed to S3 with retention config? Audit requires sampled_input_hash + link to stored blob for 90 days. Must sanitize PII before storing.

Kai: Agreed on sanitization. Implementation note: policy engine emits audit lines to eventstream with sequence id; sidecar service handles sample storage and returns sample_url in the audit payload.

Lee: Edge case: reserved dedicated pools. If fallback_target is a hosted open model, we should prefer local dedicated variant if policy.consumer_prefers_dedicated==true. Add a preference flag.

Sam: Action list: (1) Kai: proto/yaml fields PR including precedence and estimated_cost_delta, (2) Maria: console mocks for timeline + simulate + dry_run affordance, (3) Lee: cost/budget integration doc and dedicated-preference flag, (4) Sam: telemetry + audit schema with sample storage flow.

Kai: I'll open PR with examples and sample audit lines. I'll default new policies to dry_run:true and include a migration path for existing ones.

Maria: I'll mock a compact "Why?" flyout showing top signals and a mini replay button.

Lee: I'll write a short note on reserved pool handling and quota window interactions.

Sam: If we can finalize telemetry this week we can start dry-run batch replays on staging traces next Monday.

Kai: Great. Thanks everyone — will post PR and link the staging replay dashboard once the job is kicked off.
